smplSources.title: Best FP&A Software for SaaS Companies (2026) | SMPL.ai
smplSources.paragraph: Strong integrations. Ask vendors to demonstrate your specific integrations rather than just showing a logo wall. Cross-system data is particularly important for SaaS because recurring-revenue metrics often aren't available directly from the GL.
